Topic.label: Reading and analyzing frequency distribution histograms

Question: In a histogram, the frequencies for the five groups \([0,10)\), \([10,20)\), \([20,30)\), \([30,40)\), and \([40,50]\) are 3, 5, 17, 10, and 5, respectively (40 people in total). Which of the following conclusions is correct?

Choices.A: The data are most concentrated in the group \([10,20)\)
Choices.B: The data are most concentrated in the group \([20,30)\), which accounts for 42.5% of the total
Choices.C: The data are most concentrated in the group \([20,30)\), which accounts for 17% of the total
Choices.D: The data are most concentrated in the group \([30,40)\), which accounts for 25% of the total

Solution: The group \([20,30)\) has the highest frequency, 17, accounting for \(17\div40=42.5\%\). The data are most concentrated in this group.
